q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis of NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 Forward Guidance

## (a) Time left until resolution
The earnings release is scheduled for August 26, 2026. Today is August 16, 2026. This means **10 days remain** until the guidance is announced.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

NVIDIA has already provided forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 as of May 20, 2026. According to the current research, the company projected **$91.0 billion ± 2%**, which translates to a range of **$89.18 billion to $92.82 billion**.

The question asks what guidance NVIDIA will provide "in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release" on August 26, 2026. This guidance was already issued on May 20, 2026, so the company will almost certainly reaffirm or slightly adjust the prior guidance based on updated information from the intervening three months.

The most likely outcome is that NVIDIA will either:
1. **Reaffirm the $91.0B guidance** (most likely)
2. **Make a modest adjustment** of a few percentage points up or down

Given the strong momentum indicated by Q1 FY2027 results ($81.6B, up 20% QoQ and 85% YoY), and absent any major negative developments in the research summary, management is likely to maintain confidence in the $91.0B guidance.

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- **Unforeseen demand weakness** in AI chips or broader economic slowdown
- **Geopolitical restrictions** on China exports tightening unexpectedly
- **Manufacturing/supply chain disruptions** limiting production
- **Competitive pressures** intensifying unexpectedly
- **Customer inventory corrections** or pull-forward effects wearing off faster than expected
- Generally, any significant deterioration in business fundamentals over the 3 months since May 20

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- **Better-than-expected demand** for data center products
- **Stronger customer bookings** exceeding expectations
- **Accelerating AI adoption** driving higher volumes
- **Higher selling prices** realized than anticipated
- **Easing of China restrictions** allowing additional revenue recognition
- **Pull-forward from future quarters** due to capacity constraints boosting near-term demand

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

The most relevant specific precedent is NVIDIA's own May 20, 2026 guidance of **$91.0 billion ± 2%**. This is not a "base rate" in the traditional sense but rather the company's own forward-looking statement made very recently.

Historical patterns for tech companies suggest guidance adjustments are typically modest (±2-5%) quarter to quarter unless major business changes occur. NVIDIA's strong momentum (20% QoQ growth in Q1) and the short timeframe since the May guidance suggest a reaffirmation is most likely.

---

## Probability Distribution

Given that:
- NVIDIA already provided $91.0B ± 2% guidance on May 20, 2026
- Only 10 days remain until the announcement
- The company showed strong momentum through Q1
- No major negative catalysts are mentioned in the research
- The range provided (99.5B to 115.5B) extends well beyond the expected guidance band

I estimate NVIDIA's Q2 FY2027 forward guidance will cluster around the $91.0B midpoint with modest variance. There's a small tail probability of more significant moves in either direction, but the company is unlikely to dramatically raise or lower guidance in just 3 months given their recent confident outlook.

The distribution should be centered on ~$91.0B with a standard deviation of roughly 2-3% ($1.8-2.7B), reflecting:
- High probability of reaffirmation near $91.0B
- Some probability of modest upside (to $93-95B range) if demand exceeded expectations
- Some probability of modest downside (to $88-90B range) if headwinds emerged
- Low probability of extreme moves given the recent guidance

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA is expected to release its Q2 FY2027 earnings on Wednesday, August 26, 2026, with an announcement at approximately 1:20 p.m. PT followed by a conference call at 2 p.m. PT [nvidianews.nvidia.com](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-sets-conference-call-for-second-quarter-financial-results-6927195).

For Q2 FY2027, NVIDIA's outlook, as provided on May 20, 2026, projects revenue to be $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2% [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/) [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm). This guidance does not assume any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/) [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html). This figure is above the average quarterly revenue estimate of $86.84 billion according to LSEG [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html).

NVIDIA reported record Q1 FY2027 revenue of $81.6 billion, up 20% from the previous quarter and 85% year-over-year [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/) [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm).
